guarantees.claim: The LFSR seed and permutation parameters of the masking PRNG are fixed to RndCnstMaskingLfsrSeed and RndCnstMaskingLfsrPerm, preventing runtime manipulation of the PRNG's internal randomness sources.
The output net prd_masking is driven exclusively by u_aes_prng_masking.data_o, ensuring no other direct driver interferes with the masking value.

assumptions.claim: When entropy_req_o is asserted, the external entropy source must respond with entropy_ack_i and valid entropy_i in a timely manner.
assumptions.risk: PRNG may stall or produce predictable masks, compromising side-channel protection.

assumptions.claim: force_masks_i must be deasserted (0) during normal cryptographic operation; if SecAllowForcingMasks enables the port, asserting force_masks_i can force masks to known values.
assumptions.risk: Masks forced to known values can expose intermediate data and defeat masking.

assumptions.claim: prd_masking_rsd_req must be pulsed appropriately to trigger reseeding when required; missing reseeding may lead to mask reuse and reduced randomness.
assumptions.risk: Mask reuse reduces temporal randomness, weakening side-channel resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: SecSkipPRNGReseeding when true may disable reseeding of the masking PRNG; the security rationale and conditions under which this is safe are not described here.
uncertain_points.risk: The PRNG may produce predictable masks without reseeding, defeating the masking countermeasure.

uncertain_points.claim: The parent module drives force_masks_i; it is unclear whether this signal is properly gated to only test/debug states, risking accidental forcing of masks during normal operation.
uncertain_points.risk: Active force_masks_i during cryptographic operations can force masks to known values, exposing secrets.

uncertain_points.claim: WidthPRDMasking could be inconsistent with the actual data width requiring masking; no local cross-check guarantees alignment.
uncertain_points.cond: if WidthPRDMasking != expected underlying data width
uncertain_points.risk: Misaligned mask width leads to ineffective or misaligned masking, potentially leaking information.

uncertain_points.claim: The timing of prd_masking_upd relative to mask consumption in the data path is not bounded; stale or unsynchronized updates could leave data unprotected for some cycles.
uncertain_points.risk: Data processed with an old mask may create a side-channel leakage window.
